purpose: Teach: 青色/千代田/吉野/鹿島/ミシェル/帯広/朝日新聞社/小学館

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが青色のスーツを着てお出張なさるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going on a business trip in his blue suit.
lines.style: Gentle, informative tone. Speaking to a child with natural warmth. Slight lift at the end—sharing something she thinks he'll find interesting. Poised but not distant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと千代田区の博物館行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to the Chiyoda museum with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate enthusiasm. Quick attack on the opening word. Full of the energy of remembered adventure. Small voice but big feeling—he's eager to share it with her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが吉野山の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father will be reading you a picture book about Yoshino.
lines.style: Gentle anticipation in the voice. Slower pace than her previous line—she's savoring the image of this moment. Tender but observant, like she's noticing something tender about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと鹿島の試合観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the Kashima match with Dad!
lines.style: Pure, unfiltered joy. Bouncing slightly forward in the delivery. Quick pace, bright tone. The pride of having shared something with Dad. Still small but fuller, more present.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがミシェル先生の翻訳本を読んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father has been reading a translation by Michelle.
lines.style: Soft, almost musing tone. She's noticing his intellectual side. Gentle pace, slight wondering quality—like she's pleased by something she's observed about him. Warm but a little distant in the way mothers can be when thinking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと帯広の牧場行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to the ranch in Obihiro with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate. Quick delivery. The excitement of another memory—each one tumbling out easily. Same energy as before but with the added wonder of animals and wide open space in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが朝日新聞社の記事をご覧になってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was reading an article from the Asahi Shimbun.
lines.style: Observant, matter-of-fact warmth. She's noticing what he does when he thinks he's not being watched. Gentle cadence, almost conversational—she's reflecting on him to his younger brother. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと小学館の図鑑見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at the encyclopedia from Shogakukan with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, present, eager to close on this memory. Quickening slightly—the joy of discovery in his voice. Small but solid. The contentment of having shared learning with his father.
